about.label: About
about.title: Engineering with ownership

paragraphs.p1: I'm a Senior Software Engineer based in Brazil, working remotely with global teams on products where reliability, performance, and scale are non-negotiable.
paragraphs.p2: Over 7+ years, I've built platforms in fintech and SaaS — from secure transaction systems to investment platforms serving millions of users. My work sits at the intersection of system design, product engineering, and modern web architecture.
paragraphs.p3: I care deeply about the decisions that compound: how teams structure code, how systems handle growth, how products ship without sacrificing quality. I'm as comfortable discussing API boundaries and deployment strategy as I am optimizing critical user flows.
paragraphs.p4: Currently, I'm focused on AI-native product development, scalable SaaS architecture, and engineering practices that help teams move fast without breaking things.

about.closing: Open to senior, staff, and founding engineer roles where technical ownership and product impact matter.

penzack.thesis: Scaling a fintech platform to 2M+ users while maintaining performance and security.
penzack.context: Global investment platform serving 2M+ users across regulated markets. High-stakes UX where latency and reliability directly affect trust and conversion.
penzack.challenge: Deliver high-impact features under strict performance and security constraints. Balance rapid product iteration with maintainable frontend architecture at scale.
penzack.approach: Established clear component boundaries for feature teams, defined performance budgets for critical flows, and built CI-driven release confidence into every deployment.
penzack.architecture: Component boundary design for feature teams; performance budgets for critical flows; secure data handling patterns; CI-driven release confidence.
penzack.scalability: Code splitting, caching strategies, observability-friendly error boundaries, patterns that reduce regression risk as team and codebase grow.
penzack.impact: Features shipped to millions of users; measurable performance optimization; improved release reliability.
penzack.lesson: At fintech scale, frontend architecture is system design — boundaries, contracts, and observability matter as much as UI.

bullets.b2: Performance and security at fintech scale

elint.thesis: Leading large-scale Next.js migrations and data-heavy dashboards for enterprise clients.
elint.context: Enterprise clients (Lacta, Universal Music) requiring reliable data visualization and modern web stacks.
elint.challenge: Migrate legacy codebases to Next.js without disrupting production. Build performant dashboards over complex datasets.
elint.approach: Executed incremental migration with rollback plans, shared data-fetching layers, and reusable dashboard architecture across client projects.
elint.architecture: Incremental migration strategy; shared data-fetching layer; dashboard component architecture for reuse across clients.
elint.scalability: Server-side rendering for SEO and initial load; modular dashboard widgets; testing strategy for migration safety.
elint.impact: Successful platform migrations; reusable dashboard patterns; faster iteration for client delivery.
elint.lesson: Migration success depends on sequencing, rollback plans, and treating DX as a first-class requirement.

desencoder.thesis: Building secure, scalable fintech applications from full-stack ownership.
desencoder.context: Fintech startup building web applications handling thousands of daily transactions.
desencoder.challenge: Secure transaction flows, scalable backend integration, and maintainable full-stack architecture with a small team.
desencoder.approach: Designed API contracts for financial workflows, built validation layers, and established deployment pipelines for safe releases.
desencoder.architecture: API design for financial workflows; validation and error-handling contracts; deployment pipeline for safe releases.
desencoder.scalability: Database modeling for transaction integrity; horizontal-ready service boundaries; monitoring for production incidents.
desencoder.impact: Production fintech products serving thousands of daily users; secure transaction handling; foundation for team scaling.
desencoder.lesson: Early architectural choices compound — optimize for clarity and change, not premature complexity.
